messages:
mohit_infra: FYI we're seeing ap-northeast-2 warm pool bootstrap failures after the new firewall update. Warm pool down ~30% and node-agents show `kms:Decrypt AccessDenied` followed by connection resets.

rachel_sre: can you paste a sample log?

mohit_infra: sample: `2026-05-10T09:12:03Z node-agent error: keystore.Decrypt AccessDenied principal=arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/warmup-provisioner req=abc123`

rachel_sre: any recent infra changes? NAT, port ranges, inspection?

mohit_infra: rolled a firewall inspection policy that added TLS reassembly + inline inspection for outbound telemetry at 09:05. Also saw NAT ephemeral ports climb during retries.

diego_security: that inspection profile does TLS reassembly and can strip client certs for certain flows. If mutual TLS is broken the keystore-proxy will reject auth and KMS logs look sparse.

rachel_sre: immediate mitigation request: can we exempt keystore host from inspection and increase NAT capacity? both would reduce retries and restore bootstraps.

mohit_infra: applying firewall allow rule now: `allow tcp 443 from ap-warmpool-cidrs to keystore.internal:443 bypass-inspection=true comment="temp keystore bootstrap bypass"`

deploy-bot: infra action: applied firewall rule in ap-northeast-2 (ruleset v2026.05.10.13). Propagation ~70s.

mohit_infra: also added a second NAT in the AZ and widened node port range to `10240 65535` to avoid ephemeral exhaustion.

rachel_sre: warm pool rejoin in progress. seeing node retries drop and success logs starting. warm pool healthy now 88% -> 97% within 8m. nice.

diego_security: postmortem items: (1) update inspection change playbook to include a keystore handshake test, (2) add preflight query to keystore rollouts that lists active provisioning principals, (3) add an alert for NAT ephemeral port saturation tied to warm-pool health. filing SC-821.

mohit_infra: uploaded pcaps and conntrack snapshots to s3://infra-dumps/ap-northeast2/1777770000/ for the incident.

rachel_sre: agreed. I'll draft a short incident note and schedule a 45min follow-up. Please avoid re-rolling inspection until we have staging validation. :thumbsup:
